an8.78:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhu āmantesi …pe…
an8.78:1.2: chahi āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ
an8.78:1.4: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:1.8: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.78:1.9: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:1.10: imehi kho āvuso, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:2.1: pañcahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:2.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:2.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:3.1: catuhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:3.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:3.9: imehi kho āvuso, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:4.1: catuhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attano.
an8.78:4.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:4.5: no va dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti,
an8.78:4.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an8.78:4.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato alaṃ paresaṃ. nālaṃ attano.
an8.78:5.1: tīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:5.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:5.9: imehi kho āvuso, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:6.1: tīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ. nālaṃ attano
an8.78:6.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:6.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti.
an8.78:6.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an8.78:6.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attano.
an8.78:7.1: dvīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, no paresaṃ,
an8.78:7.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu.
an8.78:7.9: imehi kho āvuso, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:8.1: dvīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attano
an8.78:8.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī hoti kusalesu dhammesu.
an8.78:8.4: no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhāraṇajātiko hoti …pe…
an8.78:8.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an8.78:8.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
an8.78:8.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:8.9: imehi kho āvuso dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attanoti.
